newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: President of French Senate to visit Botswana.
newsitem.headline: President of French Senate to visit Botswana.

text.p: The President of the French Senate, Rene Monory, will visit Botswana at the invitation of President Ketumile Masire from August 21 to 24.
He will also visit Namibia from August 17 to 20.
Monory was elected president of the senate in 1992. Constitutionally he is the second most important figure in the French Republic, who would take over from the president in case of emergency.
His political career spans four decades. His home town of Loudon, of which he has been mayor since 1959, is twinned with Ouagadougou, the capital of Burkina Faso.
